items.prompt: Which key keeps the tickers "ab" and "aab" in different anagram families?

options.text: Their letter set, since order is irrelevant.
options.why: Both sets are {a,b}, so this drops the extra a and merges different multiplicities.
Sorting preserves letter counts while discarding only order.

options.text: Their first letter, which is a in both.
options.why: The first character does not encode the full letter multiset.

options.text: Their last letter, which is b in both.
options.why: The last character also loses multiplicity information.

items.explanation: Sorting preserves letter counts while discarding only order.
